comments.content: There is a stray '#endif' on line 1475 that doesn't match any '#ifdef'. The TLS block ends at line 1474, then there's an extra '#endif' before the RDMA block starts. This will cause a compilation error when USE_RDMA is defined but USE_TLS is not.

The usage string format specifier count doesn't match arguments. The format string has 4 '%s' placeholders (line 1537) but only 3 arguments are passed (version, tls_usage, rdma_usage on line 1610). This will cause undefined behavior at runtime.

There is a stray '#endif' on line 2829 that doesn't match any '#ifdef'. The TLS block ends at line 2828, then there's an extra '#endif' before the RDMA block starts. This will cause a compilation error when USE_RDMA is defined but USE_TLS is not.

The usage string format specifier count doesn't match arguments. The format string has 3 '%s' placeholders (line 3018) but only 2 arguments are passed (version, tls_usage on line 3021). The rdma_usage variable is defined but not passed to fprintf.
